title: Restricted Projection Bridge Consolidation Review
purpose: Review whether QM-like / GR-like projection comparison remains analog-only, conflict-preserving, traceable, and governance-safe.
review_findings: QM-like and GR-like domains are successfully constrained as projection analogs only.
Bridge comparison preserves shared source traceability without identity claims.
Loss differentials and conflicts remain mandatory.
Non-unification gate blocks physical derivation and theory-unification claims.
Bridge stress tests provide containment against false unification, category confusion, and projection overreading.
remaining_risks: QM-like / GR-like language may still invite physical overreading.
Shared source traceability may be misread as hidden unification.
Loss differential comparison may be mistaken for physical complementarity.
Conflict preservation may be skipped in informal explanations.

next_patch_series.title: Bridge Metrics and Trace Quality
next_patch_series.purpose: Define non-physical metrics for evaluating trace quality, loss differential clarity, coherence/conflict tracking, and projection safety.
